collection: Crystal Palace illustrations extracted from supplied book-page photographs
notes: Original phone photographs and the archive ZIP are retained locally and are not included in this repository package. Personal absolute paths and capture metadata have been removed from these publication copies.

Text transcriptions retain source wording with normalized punctuation and line wrapping. Brackets flag unavailable text. Dates and attributions are taken from the supplied pages, not independently authenticated.
The book title and author are not visible in these scans and are not guessed.
Images retain source colour, print texture, creases and glare except where a documented masked repair is made.
The unnumbered Watherston and Brogden vase has a clipped caption; its figure number is unknown.
Three repaired images have unrepaired copies and grayscale masks. White mask pixels indicate replacement; soft gray pixels indicate blending.
The 1936 fire caption prints 20 November; verify this date before publication.
Two photographed views of page 103 overlap. The elephant is extracted from IMG_6460; the Tunis Court from IMG_6459.
